delta.description: Skill improves pass rate by 44.4 percentage points overall

analyst_observations: The send-notification eval shows the smallest gap (100% vs 80%) — the baseline knows to use an app token for send and gets the params right. The only gap is it defaults to curl rather than the MCP tool.

The delete-all-messages eval shows the most important qualitative difference: the skill produces a clear STOP warning with explicit user confirmation before proceeding. The baseline mentions it's permanent but immediately presents the delete command. This safety behavior gap is the highest-value win from the skill.

The create-app-and-send eval reveals that the baseline, while functionally correct for the REST API, doesn't know the MCP-specific snake_case parameter names (default_priority vs defaultPriority) and doesn't use the MCP tool at all.

The health-and-messages eval shows a clean 2x improvement — the skill knows to use the MCP tool and that health needs no auth, while the baseline hedges with curl and asks if an MCP tool is available.
All assertions checking MCP tool usage are discriminating (always fail baseline, always pass with-skill). This is expected — the point of the skill is to direct Claude to use the MCP tool.
